body.title: Remove the older Epic and Story refs
body.summary: Remove epicRef, storyRef and storyRefs from meta.tracker and their readers: src/workflow/tracker/sync.ts, link.ts and conventions.ts, src/workflow/chain.ts, questions.ts, storage.ts and tracker-auto.ts, src/workflow/artifacts/define.ts, hld.ts, lld.ts and tracker.ts, src/workflow/runners/build/changed-files.ts, src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts, src/daemon/steps/build-step/render.ts. Update src/workflow/__tests__/define-artifact.test.ts, hld-artifact.test.ts, lld-artifact.test.ts, lld-head.test.ts, lld-head-resolve.test.ts, tracker-artifact.test.ts, tracker-push-modes.test.ts, tracker-tasks.test.ts, redraft-preserves-tracker.test.ts, draft-issues.test.ts, draft-write-revision.test.ts, id-resolve.test.ts and approve-fallback-issues.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: The Epic and Story refs are read only from the binding of the EPIC and STORY head
The renderers' tracker lines read the binding
